title: Stress Relief
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight initiates a chaotic and dangerous fire safety drill that results in Stanley suffering a heart attack, prompting Michael to organize a CPR training session. Meanwhile, Pam deals with family tension as her parents face marital problems, and the office attempts various humorous methods to relieve stress, including a roast of Michael. The episode explores themes of workplace safety, health concerns, personal relationships, and coping with stress through humor and camaraderie.
